lines.4: Some days have been feeling a little chilly lately.
lines.6: We even said, 「Let's get girlfriends this summer!」 But second term arrived without any progress to speak of.
lines.11: Naturally, Fukahire is another member of the no-girlfriend club.
lines.12: Subaru said he had morning practice today, right?
lines.13: 「You've gotta be nuts, going off to school when you forgot something so important.」
lines.14: One idiot walks right past us.
lines.18: 「Nooooooooo! Me! I mean me! How could you leave me behind!?」
lines.19: 「I only went morning-dead for a little bit, and this is what I get. It's your fault for doing a half-assed job waking me up!」
lines.21: I grab her cheek and give it a hard upward pinch.
lines.22: 「Gahh! Dat hurds! I said it hurds!」
lines.23: I let her go because she's thrashing around.
lines.25: 「Come on, you're crying from one little tug? Your tear ducts are way too loose.」
lines.27: 「I've committed this pain to memory! I'll make you cry too, so just you wait!」
lines.29: While all this is going on,
lines.31: Private Ryuumeikan Academy, comes into view.
lines.32: 「One minute until the gates close! Stop fooling around and run!」
lines.36: And so, we noisily charge toward school.
